title: Plant Infection with Xanthomonas Campestris Campestris
author: Cleo B.
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.725hqg6

steps.title: Prepare overnight culture
steps.instruction: Prepare at least 40 mL of overnight culture of Xanthomonas Campestris Campestris at 28 °C.

steps.title: Measure optical density
steps.instruction: Measure the OD600 of the overnight culture.

steps.title: Concentrate bacteria
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture for 10 minutes at 4000 rpm and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Adjust culture concentration
steps.instruction: Dissolve the pellet in H2O to reach an OD600 of 1, ensuring a final volume of at least 30 mL of diluted culture.

steps.title: Inoculate plant leaves
steps.instruction: Infect the desired leaves by dipping sterilized scissors into the diluted culture and cutting off the leaf tip.

substeps.instruction: Dip sterilized scissors in diluted culture
Cut off the tip of a leaf (about 1 cm), ensuring the cut is over the central vein
Repeat for each leaf to be infected
